column4: Same hand, same glove, same two-bar puppet control bar and same coal background as the reference, but now the whole hand has sunk lower in the frame and the bars hang loosely at a relaxed slant. The five strings below are no longer straight and taut: each one droops in a slack curve and the lowest ends loop a little, no longer reaching the bottom edge. The fingers are loose and open. No text.

Identical locked overhead camera, ledger, candle and cross-bound book as the first reference, all pages blank. A white-gloved hand with a ruffled cuff and orange sleeve (matching the pen hand in the second reference) enters from the right and holds a fountain pen poised just above the lower part of the right page, nib resting on the ruled line where an answer would go, the pen not yet writing. Five clear fingers. No text.

Same camera and scale as the reference pose. She lifts her right foot in a stiff puppet step, knee raised, the other leg straight and planted, arms slightly out and loose, head level. Three-quarter front view, not a straight frontal pose. Full-body view of the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and the approved pose: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand; no strings, no controller, no floor, no shadow. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.
